subject.title: Org claim: vmware-aiops + vmware-monitor — @kingaiwork lookalikes impersonate @zw008 listings (same pattern as #2966/#3035)

question: Should authorized staff perform scoped production remediation of any remaining duplicate skill rows and record the moderation outcome for these two slugs?
rationale: The requested action touches production moderation records and potentially destructive deletion, so source-level review cannot safely choose the retention, audit, and remediation boundary.

options.title: Authorize scoped integrity remediation
options.body: Inspect both slug records, retain required audit evidence, remove or reassign only confirmed impersonating rows, then verify scan and publish recovery for the legitimate listings.

options.title: Preserve records pending policy review
options.body: Keep the records unchanged while staff decides whether the incident requires a broader moderation-policy or retention process before destructive action.

recommendation.title: Authorize scoped integrity remediation
recommendation.body: Inspect both slug records, retain required audit evidence, remove or reassign only confirmed impersonating rows, then verify scan and publish recovery for the legitimate listings.

likelyOwner.reason: The available related history links them to the repository's organization-claim intake and policy discussion, although direct ownership of the production records is not established.
